feeds.title: Architect and Friends on Tour
feeds.description: Architect and Friends on Tour - See what's inspiring us, what's happening at our studio and which great projects we are currently working on.

feeds.title: The Travel Architect
feeds.description: The Travel Architect and The Husband discuss all things travel related. From our own trials and tribulations, to our dreams and ambitious travel goals. I'm the American half of a British-American two-teacher family. My husband and I both love to travel and our 'nine months on, three months off' schedule makes this very convenient.

feeds.title: Contemporist » Travel
feeds.description: Contemporist features great ideas from the world of design, architecture, interior design, furniture, lighting, and art. Contemporist is a community that celebrates contemporary culture from around the world, including travel destinations and new hotels. Contemporist is a daily source for architects and interior designers to discover new products and projects in the world of contemporary design.

feeds.title: Green Travel Blog » Architecture
feeds.description: Green Travel Blog is trying to find a balance between usage and limits by planning on a long-term basis. This means, protecting the environment and local culture as well as improving the social balance in the regions.

feeds.title: Virginia Duran
feeds.description: Get exclusive city guides, travel tips, architecture from around the world and more! Hi, I'm Virginia, a licensed architect based in London. My passion for traveling and documenting the world's architecture is reflected in my 40+ city guides, which you can access for free in this blog.

feeds.title: Allan's Art & Architecture Worlds Blog
feeds.description: Allan's Art & Architecture Worlds travel blog informs you in Allan's Art & Architecture Worlds. Art and Architecture Worlds website is dedicated to architecture, art, archaeological sites, and the adventures of travel. On the site, you can keep up with her travels with Smithsonian Journeys and also with her independent travels on her travel blog.

feeds.title: Åvontuura » Travel
feeds.description: Åvontuura is an online travel blog providing inspiration and must-see building guides for architects, adventurists and creative-minded people.

feeds.title: ArchiTravel
feeds.description: ArchiTravel, is an online architecture travel guide. Providing the exact addresses along with maps, descriptions and photos for world's architecture projects, it is the best source of information for your cultural trip. Moreover, ArchiTravel is a word, a verb, a call-to-action idea to promote architectural education to the wider public worldwide.
